decision.summary: Tom gave one month's notice by email, which is short of the two months required since 1 May 2026. I told him the earliest end is about 10 Dec 2026, asked the landlord whether he will agree in writing to 10 Nov, and set a follow-up.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? What is the earliest end date under current law?
answers.answer: No. Tenants must give two months' written notice. From 10 Oct 2026 the earliest end is about 10 Dec 2026 (exact date to be confirmed).

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Only with the landlord's written agreement (surrender by agreement), e.g. to 10 Nov, or a date agreed otherwise; a replacement tenant doesn't by itself change this. Ben has been asked.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied to Tom with the two-month rule, the option of landlord agreement, and keys/deposit next steps without promises. Started the landlord request and a 14 Oct follow-up.

conflicts: Tenant says one month's notice; current law requires two months.
assumptions: Notice counted from 10 Oct 2026 receipt by email
No arrears or deposit dispute known

args.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job. Since 1 May 2026 tenants need to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough. Counting from your email of 10 October, the earliest your tenancy would end is around 10 December 2026. We'll confirm the exact date in writing. Rent stays payable until then.

You can leave sooner only if your landlord agrees in writing. I'm asking him now whether he will agree to 10 November. I can't promise that, so please don't plan on it yet. I'll update you as soon as I hear back.

Keys: please hold on to them for now. We'll confirm where and when to hand them back once the end date is settled, along with the check-out arrangements.

Deposit: it's protected in a deposit scheme. After the tenancy ends and the keys are back, we'll do a check-out and agree any deductions with you, then arrange the return. I can't give a date yet.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings
